app.name: MindLoop
app.disclaimer: MindLoop is a wellbeing companion, not a medical or emergency service.
app.error: Hmm, that didn't work. Mind trying again?
app.offline: Can't reach MindLoop right now. Check your connection and try again.

landing.eyebrow: Free · private · ten seconds a day
landing.heroSub: Tap how you feel, get one small thing that actually helps, and watch a garden grow from your check-ins. No essays, no judgement, nothing to keep up with.
landing.notAlone: Feeling alone is really common. You don't have to figure it out by yourself.
landing.privacy: Private by design. Your data is never sold or used for ads.
landing.titleA: For the days that feel like
landing.howTitle: Ten seconds a day. That's the whole deal.
landing.how1: Tap a face, pick a word or two. No essays, no right answers.
landing.how2: Not a 30-day program. One doable action, chosen for what you're dealing with today.
landing.how3: Every check-in plants something in your garden — even on hard days. Over time you'll see your own patterns.
landing.f1: Guided breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding and six soundscapes generated live on your phone — for focus, panic or sleep.
landing.f2: An AI companion for venting or thinking out loud. Honest that it's not a therapist, and quick to point you to real people.
landing.f3: Ready-to-send messages for when you want to reconnect but don't know what to say.
landing.f4: A mood calendar and plain-language insights, like what tends to lift or lower your days.
landing.f5: One small reflection prompt each day. Answer in a sentence — or don't.
landing.f6: A guided thought record from CBT: spot the thinking trap, weigh the evidence, and watch how true it feels change.
landing.f7: Build your own safety plan — warning signs, what helps, who to call — with your local helplines one tap away.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

auth.invalid: That email and password don't match.

checkin.processing: Taking a moment to get it…
checkin.privacyNote: Notes are encrypted. You control whether they're kept.
checkin.moodHint: Tap the one that fits best. There's no wrong answer.
checkin.doneBody: A new plant in your garden. Thanks for showing up for yourself.
checkin.doneLow: Hard days grow things too. Thanks for checking in — it counts.

action.somethingElse: Not feeling it — show me another

reasons.context_match: It's relevant to what's affecting you.
reasons.helped_before: Similar things have helped you before.
reasons.support_recommended: Talking to a professional may help right now.

support.emergency: In immediate danger? Call your local emergency number{number}.
support.pageIntro: If you're struggling, talking to a real person can help. These services are run by trained people.

talk.title: Talk
talk.intro: Vent or think out loud. I'm an AI companion — not a therapist — and I'll point you to real people when that's what you need.
talk.voiceUnsupported: Voice recording isn't available in this browser.
talk.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. You can type instead.
talk.voiceFailed: Couldn't catch that recording. Try again or type instead.
talk.voiceNotStored: Voice recordings are deleted right after transcription.
talk.empty: No wrong way to start. Pick one or just type.

starters.exam: Exam stress is getting to me
starters.stuck: I don't know what I want to do with my life

patterns.intro: What your check-ins suggest over time. Patterns in what you've shared — not medical conclusions.
patterns.noPatterns: No clear patterns yet. Keep checking in when it suits you.

recap.title: Your week in feelings
recap.noFeelings: Add feeling words when you check in and they'll show up here.
recap.kind: Showing up is the hard part. You did that.

home.nightSub: Late nights can make everything feel louder. Be gentle with yourself.
home.weekShowedUp: You checked in {count} of the last 7 days
home.weekStart: Your first check-in plants your first seed
home.pulseNote: Anonymous counts — only shown when at least 5 people share them.
home.lonelyNudge: Feeling alone is so common, and it doesn't mean something's wrong with you. Want help reaching out to someone?
home.checkinSub: Ten seconds. Tap a face to start.
home.reflectSub: Two short exercises that help thoughts feel lighter.

calm.title: Calm
calm.intro: Quick resets for when your mind's loud. Most take a minute or two.
calm.publicIntro: No account, no sign-up. Just a minute for you.
calm.publicCta: Want check-ins and a companion too? Make a free space

breathe.done: Nice. Notice how your body feels now.
breathe.tip: Breathe through your nose if you can. Stop any time it feels uncomfortable.

ground.intro: Pulls your attention out of your head and into the room. Tap once for each thing you notice.
ground.touch: things you can feel or touch
ground.done: You're here, right now. That's enough for this moment.

sounds.title: Calm sounds
sounds.intro: Generated live on your device — nothing downloads. Best with headphones.

calm.reachTitle: Want to talk to someone you know?
calm.reachSub: Ready-to-send messages for when it's hard to start

connect.title: Connect
connect.intro: Loneliness lies — it says no one wants to hear from you. Usually, they do. Pick a message, tweak it, send it.

reconnect: Hey! Saw something today that reminded me of you 😄 how've you been?
It's been way too long — what's new with you?
Random thought: I miss our chats. How's life?
hangout: Wanna grab chai/coffee this week? My treat next time 😅
I'm going for a walk later — wanna come?
Free this weekend? Would love to catch up properly.
share: Hey, it's been a rough few days. Can I vent to you for a bit?
Not feeling great lately — do you have time to talk sometime?
I don't need advice, just could use some company. You around?
checkon: Hey, just checking in — how are you actually doing?
Thinking of you today. No need to reply if you're busy 💛
You've seemed quiet lately. I'm here if you want to talk.

connect.sentNote: Sending it is the brave part. Whatever they reply — or don't — you did something kind for yourself.
connect.missionsIntro: Low-pressure ways to feel a bit more connected today. Tap to tick off.

missions.reply: Reply to a message you've been leaving on read
missions.voice: Send a voice note instead of a text
missions.eat: Eat a meal with someone, or near people
missions.hi: Say hi to someone you see often but never talk to
missions.group: Drop something fun in a group chat
missions.outside: Spend 10 minutes somewhere with other people around
missions.family: Call a family member just to chat

connect.noOneTitle: If no one comes to mind
connect.noOne: That happens, especially after a move or a tough year. Clubs, volunteering, sports or study groups are low-pressure ways to meet people. And trained listeners are always there — it's okay to reach out to them too.
connect.noOneCta: See people you can talk to

library.intro: Short, structured exercises. Each takes a few minutes — pick one any time.

profile.title: You
profile.contextHint: This helps MindLoop use the right language, examples and support options. Correct anything that's wrong.
profile.notesLabel: Anything else that helps MindLoop support you? (optional)

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.intro: Your data is yours. MindLoop never sells it, never uses it for advertising, and never shares individual data with colleges or employers.

consent.data_processing: Process my check-ins to provide the service (required)
consent.store_journal: Keep my typed notes and journal entries
consent.store_transcripts: Keep transcripts of voice messages (audio is never kept)
consent.memory: Remember helpful things I share across conversations
consent.analytics: Share anonymous usage counts to improve MindLoop

privacy.withdrawNote: Turning a setting off also deletes the data it covered.

deleteScope.journal: Delete all typed notes and journal entries
deleteScope.reflections: Delete all journal entries (reframes, good things)

privacy.accountHint: Permanently deletes your account and everything in it.

metrics.title: Internal metrics
metrics.intro: Aggregate counts only. No individual data.

journey.title: Look what you've grown.
journey.daysNote: Not in a row — in total. Every day counts, whenever it happens.
journey.gardenEmpty: Your first check-in plants your first seed.
journey.gardenNote: Every day you check in plants something — sunflowers on bright days, bluebells and seedlings on hard ones. Nothing wilts while you're away.
journey.unlockIn: {count} more check-ins to unlock your patterns
journey.momentsNote: Moments only ever add up. Nothing to keep up with, nothing to lose.
journey.reportSub: A printable one-page summary you can keep or share with a counsellor.

reflect.title: Reflect
reflect.intro: Two short exercises drawn from cognitive behavioural therapy and positive psychology. What you write is encrypted, and only you can see it.
reflect.reframeSub: When a thought is weighing on you, slow it down and look at it from another angle.
reflect.gratitudeSub: Write down up to three things that went well today, however small.
reflect.empty: Nothing here yet. Your entries will show up here.
reflect.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? This can't be undone.
reflect.journalOff: Saving journal entries is turned off in your privacy settings, so nothing written here can be kept.
reflect.notTherapy: These are self-help exercises, not therapy. If things feel too heavy, talk to someone you trust or a professional.

reframe.situationHint: Just the facts, the way a camera would see it.
reframe.situationPlaceholder: e.g. My friend didn't reply to my message all day.
reframe.thoughtHint: Write the thought that stings the most, in your own words.
reframe.thoughtPlaceholder: e.g. They don't really care about me.
reframe.beliefLabel: How true does it feel right now?
reframe.trapsHint: Minds take shortcuts, especially under stress. Tap any that fit, or skip if none do.
reframe.againstPlaceholder: Anything that points the other way?
reframe.balancedHint: What would you say to a good friend who had this thought?
reframe.balancedPlaceholder: e.g. They're probably busy. One quiet day doesn't mean they don't care.
reframe.beliefAfterLabel: How true does the original thought feel now?
reframe.doneBody: Looking closely at a thought is a skill, and you just practised it.
reframe.shiftNone: Even if it still feels true, you looked at it more closely. That counts.

all_or_nothing.label: All-or-nothing
all_or_nothing.desc: Seeing things as total success or total failure.

catastrophizing.label: Catastrophising
catastrophizing.desc: Jumping straight to the worst outcome.

mind_reading.label: Mind reading
mind_reading.desc: Assuming you know what others are thinking.

fortune_telling.label: Fortune telling
fortune_telling.desc: Predicting that things will go badly.

labeling.label: Labelling
labeling.desc: Calling yourself a name instead of describing what happened.

should_statements.label: Shoulds
should_statements.desc: Rigid rules about how you or others must be.

emotional_reasoning.label: Emotional reasoning
emotional_reasoning.desc: “I feel it, so it must be true.”

personalizing.label: Personalising
personalizing.desc: Taking the blame for things outside your control.

comparing.label: Comparing
comparing.desc: Measuring yourself against other people's highlights.

gratitude.title: What went well today?
gratitude.hint: Small counts. A good cup of chai, a kind message, a moment of sun.
gratitude.label: Good thing {n}
gratitude.whyLabel: Why do you think they happened? (optional)
gratitude.whyPlaceholder: Noticing your part in good moments helps them stick.
gratitude.doneBody: Pausing on the good stuff trains your attention to find it more often.

safetyPlan.title: My safety plan
safetyPlan.intro: A plan you make while you're feeling steady, to use when things get hard. It follows the Stanley-Brown safety plan that many counsellors use. It's encrypted, and only you can see it.

warning_signs.title: Warning signs
warning_signs.hint: Thoughts, feelings or situations that tell me a hard moment might be coming.
warning_signs.placeholder: e.g. I stop replying to people

coping.title: Things I can do on my own
coping.hint: Ways to take my mind off things without contacting anyone.
coping.placeholder: e.g. Cold shower, then a walk

distractions.title: People and places that give me a break
distractions.hint: Somewhere to go or someone to be around, without having to talk about it.

people.title: People I can ask for help
people.hint: Someone I trust and can tell how I'm really doing.

professionals.title: Professionals I can contact
professionals.hint: A counsellor, doctor or service. The helplines below are always here too.

safe_environment.title: Making my space safer
safe_environment.hint: Ways to keep myself safe, like putting things out of reach or asking someone to hold onto them.
safe_environment.placeholder: e.g. Leave my phone outside the room at night

reasons.title: What matters most to me
reasons.hint: The people, plans and small things worth holding on for.

safetyPlan.saved: Saved. Your plan is here whenever you need it.
safetyPlan.empty: You haven't made a plan yet. It takes about ten minutes, and you can fill in as much or as little as you like.
safetyPlan.helplinesHint: If you're in danger right now, call your local emergency number.
safetyPlan.deleteConfirm: Delete your safety plan? This can't be undone.
safetyPlan.cardSub: Your own steps for getting through a hard moment.

report.title: The last {days} days
report.intro: A one-page summary of what you've logged, to keep for yourself or bring to a counsellor or doctor if you'd like. It shows what you reported. It isn't an assessment.
report.moodDist: How often each mood came up
report.noData: Nothing was logged in this period.
report.generated: Made with MindLoop on {date}. Based only on what the person chose to log. Not a medical record, assessment or diagnosis.
